subject: Request: admin-activity snapshot & sampling plan for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: sample admin-activity snapshots for SOC 2 review

Hi Karthik,

We're working through our SOC 2 vendor review and need a short sample of Redwood's admin-activity/audit logs to validate coverage and retention controls. Specifically can you provide: 

- A 7-day snapshot of admin activity (preferably 2026-11-24 thru 2026-11-30) including fields: actor_id, action, target_resource, timestamp, originating_ip, region, and a boolean for whether the action modified data.
- A manifest describing what was excluded/redacted (PII handling).
- Chain-of-custody metadata (who exported, checksum, encryption used).
- Confirmation of retention windows and any sampling policy for older events.

Delivery: a single encrypted bundle (prefer S3 pre-signed link OR PGP-encrypted attachment). We attached the SOC2 questionnaire section for logs for reference.

Attachment: soc2_questionnaire_acme_v1.pdf (pdf)

Can you confirm feasibility and estimated delivery by 2026-12-17?

Thanks,
Maria
---
Maria Gomez
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: sample admin-activity snapshots for SOC 2 review

Maria — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. We can provide a limited, redacted package that meets the SOC 2 review needs. Proposed plan below; please confirm if that aligns with your expectations.

Proposed snapshot/package (delivery options: encrypted S3 presigned link or PGP):
- Timebox: 7-day window you requested (we'll use 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-30 unless you request different dates).
- Event set: admin.* and operator.* event types + auth.login events for context (examples: admin.create_user, admin.update_role, operator.run_migration).
- Fields included: event_id, actor_id (hashed), actor_email_removed, action, target_type, target_id (hashed if PII), timestamp (ISO8601), originating_ip (masked /24), region, outcome (success/failure), request_id, modified_data_flag.
- Redaction: PII (emails, full IP) will be hashed or masked. We will include a manifest describing transformations.
- Sampling: full fidelity for the 7-day window. For retention/older windows we apply a 10% deterministic sample for admin events older than 90 days (seeded by event_id) — we will document the sampling algorithm in the manifest.
- Chain-of-custody: exported_by, export_time, SHA256 checksums of each file, encryption algorithm (AES-256) and KMS key id.

Timeline & owners:
- Today: confirm dates and delivery method (Maria).
- 48 hours: infra run to prepare raw snapshot and manifest (Laura).
- +24 hours: privacy redaction & sampling checks (Marissa).
- +72 hours: package, checksum, and upload; I'll coordinate delivery and send link via separate secure channel (me).

Attachments we will produce: admin_snapshot_manifest.jsonl.gz, chain_of_custody.txt, admin_snapshot_20261201_partition.tar.gz (the archive will contain JSONL files per day).

Open items for you: Does Acme need original IP addresses preserved in any form (we can provide truncated prefixes for location checks)? Also confirm whether the sample should include system-internal service accounts or be limited to human admins.

If that's okay I'll kick off with Laura and Marissa.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: sample admin-activity snapshots for SOC 2 review

On Thu, Dec 10, 2026 at 11:04 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Maria — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. We can provide a limited, redacted package that meets the SOC 2 review needs. Proposed plan below; please confirm if that aligns with your expectations.

Folks — I ran the extraction job with the agreed event filters and produced an initial package. Notes:
- Files generated: admin_events_20261124.jsonl.gz, admin_events_20261125.jsonl.gz, admin_events_20261126.jsonl.gz, admin_events_20261127.jsonl.gz, admin_events_20261128.jsonl.gz, admin_events_20261129.jsonl.gz, admin_events_20261130.jsonl.gz.
- Each line is JSON with fields per Karthik's spec. We applied deterministic hashing for actor_id and target_id using HMAC-SHA256 with a per-tenant salt (documented in manifest).
- IP handling: original IPs are stored in a separate encrypted file (ip_map_20261124-1130.enc) accessible only to the compliance team; exported samples contain masked IPs (first 3 octets preserved).
- Attachments: I created the archive admin_snapshot_20261201_partition.tar.gz and computed checksums.

Attachment stub: admin_snapshot_20261201_partition.tar.gz (tar.gz, ~120MB)
Attachment stub: admin_snapshot_manifest.jsonl.gz (jsonl.gz)
Attachment stub: chain_of_custody.txt (txt)

Commands used to generate sample (for Acme's reviewers):
- Export: /opt/infra/bin/audit-export --start 2026-11-24 --end 2026-11-30 --types admin,operator,auth.login --out /tmp/admin_snapshot/
- Redact: /opt/infra/bin/redact --input /tmp/admin_snapshot/ --salt env:ACME_SALT --mask-ip /24 --hash-fields actor_id,target_id --manifest /tmp/admin_snapshot/manifest.json

We can deliver via an S3 presigned URL or upload to Acme's secure bucket if you provide an inbound role. Karthik — I'll hand this to Marissa for the privacy checks and final packaging.

Laura
Principal Software Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: sample admin-activity snapshots for SOC 2 review

Karthik / Laura — this looks great and addresses our primary questions.

Quick confirmations:
- Delivery via presigned S3 link is fine. Please include checksums and the chain_of_custody.txt in the top-level of the bundle.
- We do not need original IPs — masked /24 is acceptable for the audit.
- Include service accounts in the extract; we'll note them in the reviewer notes.

Target delivery: 2026-12-17 works. Once you upload, please email the presigned URL and separate PGP passphrase (do not include passphrase in the same channel).

Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Maria
